5503.title: Native download navigation lacks a file handoff
5503.rootCauseOneLine: Download anchors reach ordinary shell navigation: root profiles admit the file URL, while prefixed profiles select external browsing; there is no native file-save handoff.
5503.proposedFix: Design a capability-negotiated native file-save handoff with scoped authenticated transfer and blob support, plus WebView download safety nets; verify on iOS before shipping.
5503.caveats: Two clean trusted-main runs reproduce policy-level routing only. No iOS runtime, Safari cookie/name check, raw-byte rendering, recovery check, or screenshot. Test and assertion output are embedded inline per reports repository policy. Fix exceeds the simple-fix protocol/security and subsystem limits.
